325
326    uint64_t edgeCount = 0;
327
328    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
329    // Enumerate the reachable representatives. Nothing is solved; the edges are
330    // only counted.
331    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
332    bool aborted = false;
333    for (size_t qi = 0; qi < states.size(); qi++) {
334        if (stateLimit && states.size() >= stateLimit) { aborted = true; break; }
335        if ((qi & 0xFFFFFF) == 0 && qi) {
336            std::printf("  enumerating: expanded %zu / known %zu\n", qi, states.size());
337            std::fflush(stdout);
338        }
339        const State s = states[qi];
340        uint64_t t = s.cur;
341        while (t) {
342            const int from = __builtin_ctzll(t);
343            t &= t - 1;
344            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
345                State nx;
346                int winner;
347                if (!applyMove(s, from, d, nx, winner)) continue;
348                if (__builtin_popcountll(nx.cur) < PMIN) continue;   // playing it wins at once: terminal
349                if (__builtin_popcountll(nx.opp) < PMIN) continue;   // playing it loses at once: terminal
350                bool isNew;
351                getId(canonical(nx), isNew);
352            }
353        }
354    }
355    if (aborted) {
356        std::printf("enumeration stopped at the limit of %llu. ABORTED\n", (unsigned long long)stateLimit);
357        return 2;
358    }
359    const auto t1 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
360
361    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
362    // Counting.
363    //   For each representative s take the size o(s) of its orbit, then
364    //     reachable states += o(s)
365    //     positions (= edges) += o(s) x (number of moves to a non-terminal state)
366    //   and classify by the outcome of the position reached. Outcomes are
367    //   invariant under reflection, so the representative's value may be used.
368    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
369    rankgenq::init(N, M, M, Q);
370    const uint64_t TOTAL = rankgenq::TOTAL_CNT;
371    std::vector<uint8_t> value;
372    bool haveV = false;
373    if (const char* vf = std::getenv("LOAD_VALUES")) {
374        value.assign(TOTAL, 0);
375        FILE* fp = std::fopen(vf, "rb");
376        if (!fp) { std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", vf); return 1; }
377        const size_t got = std::fread(value.data(), 1, value.size(), fp);
378        std::fclose(fp);
379        if (got != value.size()) { std::fprintf(stderr, "size mismatch %zu != %zu\n", got, value.size()); return 1; }
380        haveV = true;
381    }
382    auto getV = [&](uint64_t i) -> uint8_t { return haveV ? value[i] : 0; };
383
384    uint64_t nState = 0, nPos = 0, moveCount = 0, dupCfg = 0;
385    uint64_t sW = 0, sL = 0, sD = 0;      // reachable states classified by outcome
386    uint64_t pW = 0, pL = 0, pD = 0;      // positions classified by the outcome they lead to
387    for (size_t i = 0; i < states.size(); i++) {
388        const State s = states[i];
389        // size of the orbit
390        State orb[4]; int no = 0;
391        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
392            const bool h = k & 1, v = k & 2;
393            State x{ flipMask(s.cur, h, v), flipMask(s.opp, h, v), flipMove(s.ban, h, v) };
394            bool dup = false;
395            for (int j = 0; j < no; j++) if (orb[j] == x) { dup = true; break; }
396            if (!dup) orb[no++] = x;
397        }
398        const uint64_t o = (uint64_t)no;
399        nState += o;
400        const uint8_t vs = getV(rankgenq::stateIndex(s.cur, s.opp, s.ban));
401        if (vs == 1) sW += o; else if (vs == 2) sL += o; else sD += o;
402
403        // A position is (previous configuration, current configuration, player to
404        // move), so moves reaching the same configuration count once. Whether the
405        // number of moves differs from the number of configurations is measured too.
406        State ch[80]; int nch = 0, moves = 0;
407        uint64_t t2 = s.cur;
408        while (t2) {
409            const int from = __builtin_ctzll(t2);
410            t2 &= t2 - 1;
411            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
412                State nx; int winner;
413                if (!applyMove(s, from, d, nx, winner)) continue;
414                if (__builtin_popcountll(nx.cur) < PMIN) continue;
415                if (__builtin_popcountll(nx.opp) < PMIN) continue;
416                moves++;
417                bool dup = false;
418                for (int j = 0; j < nch; j++)
419                    if (ch[j].cur == nx.cur && ch[j].opp == nx.opp) { dup = true; break; }
420                if (dup) { dupCfg += o; continue; }
421                if (nch < 80) ch[nch++] = nx;
422                const State c = canonical(nx);
423                const uint8_t v = getV(rankgenq::stateIndex(c.cur, c.opp, c.ban));
424                if (v == 1) pW += o; else if (v == 2) pL += o; else pD += o;
425            }
426        }
427        moveCount += o * (uint64_t)moves;
428        edgeCount += o * (uint64_t)nch;
429    }
430    nPos = edgeCount + 1;   // the initial position has no previous configuration, so it is counted separately
431    const auto t2 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
432
433    std::printf("========================================\n");
434    std::printf(" position count for %d x %d, capture threshold %d\n", N, M, Q);
435    std::printf("========================================\n");
436    std::printf("representatives (modulo reflection) : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)states.size());
437    std::printf("reachable states (unreflected)      : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)nState);
438    std::printf("  wins / losses / draws             : %llu / %llu / %llu\n",
439                (unsigned long long)sW, (unsigned long long)sL, (unsigned long long)sD);
440    std::printf("----------------------------------------\n");
441    std::printf("positions (edges + initial position): %llu\n", (unsigned long long)nPos);
442    std::printf("  for reference, legal moves        : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)moveCount);
443    std::printf("  ... reaching the same configuration: %llu %s\n", (unsigned long long)dupCfg,
444                dupCfg ? "** moves and configurations differ" : "(they agree)");
445    std::printf("  leading to win / loss / draw      : %llu / %llu / %llu\n",
446                (unsigned long long)pW, (unsigned long long)pL, (unsigned long long)pD);
447    std::printf("----------------------------------------\n");
448    std::printf("all indexed states (forbidden-move encoding): %llu\n", (unsigned long long)TOTAL);
449    std::printf("enumeration %.2f s / counting %.2f s\n",
450                std::chrono::duration<double>(t1 - t0).count(),
451                std::chrono::duration<double>(t2 - t1).count());
452    std::printf("========================================\n");
453    return 0;
454}

src/qdupcheck.cpp

 1// Checks that, under capture threshold q, the fact that two different moves can
 2// reach the same configuration does not affect how the repetition rule is
 3// stored. Concretely: whenever two moves reach the same configuration, at least
 4// one of them must push a marker off the board.
 5//
 6// If two moves that leave the marker counts unchanged could reach the same
 7// configuration, then storing the forbidden move as a single reverse move would
 8// disagree with the rule in the paper, which forbids every move returning to the
 9// previous configuration.
10#include "rankgenq.h"
11#include <cstdio>
12#include <cstdlib>
13#include <vector>
14static int NR,NC,NCELL,NPIECE,Q,PMIN;
15static const int DR[4]={-1,1,0,0}, DC[4]={0,0,-1,1};
16static const uint8_t NO_MOVE=0xFF;
17static inline bool inBoard(int r,int c){return r>=0&&r<NR&&c>=0&&c<NC;}
18static inline bool applyMove(uint64_t cur,uint64_t opp,uint8_t ban,int from,int d,
19                             uint64_t&ncur,uint64_t&nopp,uint8_t&nban,int&winner){
20  if(!((cur>>from)&1ULL))return false;
21  if(ban!=NO_MOVE&&ban==(uint8_t)((from<<2)|d))return false;
22  const uint64_t occ=cur|opp; const int dr=DR[d],dc=DC[d];
23  int line[64],len=1; line[0]=from;
24  int rr=from/NC+dr,cc=from%NC+dc; int dest=inBoard(rr,cc)?rr*NC+cc:-1;
25  while(dest>=0&&((occ>>dest)&1ULL)){line[len++]=dest;rr=dest/NC+dr;cc=dest%NC+dc;dest=inBoard(rr,cc)?rr*NC+cc:-1;}
26  ncur=cur;nopp=opp;winner=0;int hole=dest;
27  for(int i=len-1;i>=0;i--){const uint64_t bit=1ULL<<line[i];
28    if(ncur&bit){ncur^=bit; if(hole<0)winner=2; else ncur|=1ULL<<hole;}
29    else{nopp^=bit; if(hole<0)winner=1; else nopp|=1ULL<<hole;} hole=line[i];}
30  nban=NO_MOVE;
31  if(winner==0&&dest>=0&&((nopp>>dest)&1ULL)) nban=(uint8_t)((dest<<2)|(d^1));
32  const uint64_t t=ncur;ncur=nopp;nopp=t;
33  return true;
34}
35int main(int argc,char**argv){
36  NR=atoi(argv[1]);NC=atoi(argv[2]);NPIECE=NC;Q=atoi(argv[3]);
37  NCELL=NR*NC;PMIN=NPIECE-Q+1;
38  rankgenq::init(NR,NC,NPIECE,Q);
39  const uint64_t TOTAL=rankgenq::TOTAL_CNT;
40  uint64_t dupTotal=0, dupNoDrop=0, dupBanDiffer=0;
41  for(uint64_t i=0;i<TOTAL;i++){
42    uint64_t cur,opp;uint8_t ban; rankgenq::stateUnindex(i,cur,opp,ban);
43    struct C{uint64_t a,b;uint8_t nb;int drop;};
44    C buf[80];int n=0;
45    for(int from=0;from<NCELL;from++){
46      if(!((cur>>from)&1ULL))continue;
47      for(int d=0;d<4;d++){
48        uint64_t nc,no;uint8_t nb;int w;
49        if(!applyMove(cur,opp,ban,from,d,nc,no,nb,w))continue;
50        if(__builtin_popcountll(nc)<PMIN||__builtin_popcountll(no)<PMIN)continue;
51        const int drop=(w!=0);
52        for(int j=0;j<n;j++) if(buf[j].a==nc&&buf[j].b==no){
53          dupTotal++;
54          if(!drop&&!buf[j].drop) dupNoDrop++;      // neither move removed a marker
55          if(buf[j].nb!=nb) dupBanDiffer++;          // the stored forbidden move differs
56        }
57        if(n<80) buf[n++]=C{nc,no,nb,drop};
58      }
59    }
60  }
61  printf("%d x %d, capture threshold %d, %llu states\n",NR,NC,Q,(unsigned long long)TOTAL);
62  printf("  move pairs reaching the same configuration : %llu\n",(unsigned long long)dupTotal);
63  printf("  ... with no marker removed                : %llu  %s\n",(unsigned long long)dupNoDrop,
64         dupNoDrop? "** the forbidden-move encoding is unsound":"<- zero means sound");
65  printf("  ... with differing forbidden moves        : %llu  %s\n",(unsigned long long)dupBanDiffer,
66         dupBanDiffer? "** needs checking":"<- zero means sound");
67  return dupNoDrop||dupBanDiffer;
68}

src/rankgenqtest.cpp

 1// Checks that the ranking in rankgenq.h is a bijection.
 2//
 3//  (1) index -> position -> index is the identity (exhaustively, or sampled)
 4//  (2) the total number of states matches the value from binomials
 5//  (3) for q=1, every index agrees with rankgen.h
 6//      (for q=1 the blocks collapse to one, so the numbering must stay
 7//      compatible with the earlier results)
 8#include "rankgen.h"
 9#include "rankgenq.h"
10#include <cstdio>
11#include <cstdlib>
12#include <cstdint>
13
14static uint64_t binomOf(int n, int k) {
15  if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
16  uint64_t r = 1;
17  for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) r = r * (n - i) / (i + 1);
18  return r;
19}
20
21int main(int argc, char** argv) {
22  const int NR = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 4;
23  const int NC = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 3;
24  const int NP = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : NC;
25  const int Q  = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 1;
26  const uint64_t STEP = argc > 5 ? strtoull(argv[5], nullptr, 10) : 1;
27  rankgenq::init(NR, NC, NP, Q);
28  const int NCELL = NR * NC;
29  const uint64_t TOTAL = rankgenq::TOTAL_CNT;
30
31  // (2) check the total against binomials
32  uint64_t expect = 0;
33  const int PMIN = NP - Q + 1;
34  for (int a = PMIN; a <= NP; a++)
35    for (int b = PMIN; b <= NP; b++)
36      expect += binomOf(NCELL, a) * binomOf(NCELL - a, b) * (4ULL * a + 1);
37  printf("board %dx%d, %d markers each, capture threshold %d\n", NR, NC, NP, Q);
38  printf("  states       : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)TOTAL);
39  printf("  from binomials: %llu  -> %s\n", (unsigned long long)expect,
40         TOTAL == expect ? "match" : "** MISMATCH");
41  if (TOTAL != expect) return 1;
42
43  // per-block breakdown
44  for (int a = PMIN; a <= NP; a++)
45    for (int b = PMIN; b <= NP; b++)
46      printf("  block(%d,%d) first %14llu  count %14llu\n", a, b,
47             (unsigned long long)rankgenq::SEC_OFF[a][b],
48             (unsigned long long)rankgenq::SEC_CNT[a][b]);
49
50  // (1) round trip
51  uint64_t checked = 0, bad = 0;
52  for (uint64_t i = 0; i < TOTAL; i += STEP) {
53    uint64_t cur, opp; uint8_t ban;
54    rankgenq::stateUnindex(i, cur, opp, ban);
55    if (__builtin_popcountll(cur & opp)) { bad++; continue; }   // overlapping markers would be a bug
56    const uint64_t back = rankgenq::stateIndex(cur, opp, ban);
57    if (back != i) { if (bad < 5) printf("  ** round trip failed %llu -> %llu\n",
58                                        (unsigned long long)i, (unsigned long long)back); bad++; }
59    checked++;
60  }
61  printf("  round trip   : %llu checked / %llu mismatched -> %s\n",
62         (unsigned long long)checked, (unsigned long long)bad, bad ? "** NG" : "OK");
63  if (bad) return 1;
64
65  // (3) for q=1 the indices must agree with rankgen.h exactly
66  if (Q == 1) {
67    rankgen::init(NR, NC, NP);
68    if (rankgen::TOTAL_CNT != TOTAL) { printf("  ** total differs from rankgen\n"); return 1; }
69    uint64_t d = 0, n = 0;
70    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < TOTAL; i += STEP) {
71      uint64_t cur, opp; uint8_t ban;
72      rankgenq::stateUnindex(i, cur, opp, ban);
73      if (rankgenq::stateIndex(cur, opp, ban) != rankgen::stateIndex(cur, opp, ban)) d++;
74      n++;
75    }
76    printf("  vs rankgen   : %llu checked / %llu differed -> %s\n",
77           (unsigned long long)n, (unsigned long long)d, d ? "** NG" : "OK");
78    if (d) return 1;
79  }
80  printf("  => all checks passed\n\n");
81  return 0;
82}

src/rankgen.h

  1// Numbers configurations and forbidden moves into consecutive integers, for any
  2// board size and marker count.
  3//
  4// ## Why it is general
  5//
  6// Before attacking 5x5 it is worth running the same code on small boards with
  7// known values (4x3, 4x4) and comparing. Fixing the board size would make that
  8// impossible.
  9//
 10// ## Assumption
 11//
 12// With capture threshold one the game ends the moment a marker is removed, so a
 13// non-terminal state always has p markers on each side. With the count fixed, the
 14// configuration can be ranked directly and no hash table is needed.
 15//
 16// ## Range of the forbidden move
 17//
 18// The square a forbidden move starts from always holds a marker of the player to
 19// move; the collapsing of lapsed restrictions normalises it that way. The range is
 20// therefore NONE + (p own markers x 4 directions) = 4p + 1 values, not
 21// squares x 4 + 1. Getting this wrong inflates the space several fold.
 22#pragma once
 23#include <cstdint>
 24
 25namespace rankgen {
 26
 27static int NR = 4, NC = 4, NCELL = 16, NPIECE = 4;
 28static uint64_t BINOM[64][16];
 29static uint64_t FIRST_CNT, SECOND_CNT, PLACE_CNT, BAN_CNT, TOTAL_CNT;
 30
 31inline uint64_t binom(int n, int k) {
 32  if (k < 0 || n < 0 || k > n || n >= 64 || k >= 16) return 0;
 33  return BINOM[n][k];
 34}
 35
 36inline void init(int nr, int nc, int npiece) {
 37  NR = nr; NC = nc; NCELL = nr * nc; NPIECE = npiece;
 38  for (int n = 0; n < 64; n++) {
 39    BINOM[n][0] = 1;
 40    for (int k = 1; k < 16; k++)
 41      BINOM[n][k] = (k > n) ? 0 : BINOM[n - 1][k - 1] + BINOM[n - 1][k];
 42  }
 43  FIRST_CNT = binom(NCELL, NPIECE);
 44  SECOND_CNT = binom(NCELL - NPIECE, NPIECE);
 45  PLACE_CNT = FIRST_CNT * SECOND_CNT;
 46  BAN_CNT = 4 * (uint64_t)NPIECE + 1;   // NONE + p own markers x 4 directions
 47  TOTAL_CNT = PLACE_CNT * BAN_CNT;
 48}
 49
 50// Bitmask to its combinadic rank; mask has k bits set.
 51inline uint64_t maskToRank(uint64_t mask) {
 52  uint64_t r = 0;
 53  int i = 1;
 54  while (mask) {
 55    const int p = __builtin_ctzll(mask);
 56    mask &= mask - 1;
 57    r += binom(p, i);
 58    i++;
 59  }
 60  return r;
 61}
 62
 63// Rank back to a mask with k bits set; n is the number of squares.
 64inline uint64_t rankToMask(uint64_t r, int n, int k) {
 65  uint64_t mask = 0;
 66  for (int i = k; i >= 1; i--) {
 67    int p = i - 1;
 68    while (p + 1 <= n - 1 && binom(p + 1, i) <= r) p++;
 69    mask |= 1ULL << p;
 70    r -= binom(p, i);
 71    n = p;
 72  }
 73  return mask;
 74}
 75
 76// Maps into the coordinate system that skips the occupied squares.
 77inline uint64_t compress(uint64_t mask, uint64_t occupied) {
 78  uint64_t out = 0;
 79  int idx = 0;
 80  for (int i = 0; i < NCELL; i++) {
 81    if ((occupied >> i) & 1ULL) continue;
 82    if ((mask >> i) & 1ULL) out |= 1ULL << idx;
 83    idx++;
 84  }
 85  return out;
 86}
 87
 88inline uint64_t expand(uint64_t cmask, uint64_t occupied) {
 89  uint64_t out = 0;
 90  int idx = 0;
 91  for (int i = 0; i < NCELL; i++) {
 92    if ((occupied >> i) & 1ULL) continue;
 93    if ((cmask >> idx) & 1ULL) out |= 1ULL << i;
 94    idx++;
 95  }
 96  return out;
 97}
 98
 99inline uint64_t placementRank(uint64_t cur, uint64_t opp) {
100  return maskToRank(cur) * SECOND_CNT + maskToRank(compress(opp, cur));
101}
102
103inline void placementUnrank(uint64_t r, uint64_t &cur, uint64_t &opp) {
104  cur = rankToMask(r / SECOND_CNT, NCELL, NPIECE);
105  opp = expand(rankToMask(r % SECOND_CNT, NCELL - NPIECE, NPIECE), cur);
106}
107
108// Maps the forbidden move (from, dir) to 0..4p. "from" must hold a marker of the
109// player to move. 0 means NONE; 1..4p is (index of that marker x 4 + direction) + 1.
110inline uint32_t banRank(uint64_t cur, uint8_t ban) {
111  if (ban == 0xFF) return 0;
112  const int from = ban >> 2, d = ban & 3;
113  const uint64_t below = cur & ((1ULL << from) - 1);
114  const int idx = __builtin_popcountll(below);
115  return (uint32_t)(idx * 4 + d + 1);
116}
117
118// Inverse of banRank: recovers the actual (from, dir) from cur.
119inline uint8_t banUnrank(uint64_t cur, uint32_t br) {
120  if (br == 0) return 0xFF;
121  br--;
122  const int idx = br / 4, d = br % 4;
123  uint64_t m = cur;
124  for (int i = 0; i < idx; i++) m &= m - 1;
125  const int from = __builtin_ctzll(m);
126  return (uint8_t)((from << 2) | d);
127}
128
129inline uint64_t stateIndex(uint64_t cur, uint64_t opp, uint8_t ban) {
130  return placementRank(cur, opp) * BAN_CNT + banRank(cur, ban);
131}
132
133inline void stateUnindex(uint64_t idx, uint64_t &cur, uint64_t &opp, uint8_t &ban) {
134  placementUnrank(idx / BAN_CNT, cur, opp);
135  ban = banUnrank(cur, (uint32_t)(idx % BAN_CNT));
136}
137
138}  // namespace rankgen

src/solveidx.cpp

  1// Complete retrograde analysis over the whole indexed state space.
  2//
  3// ## Difference from the hash-table approach
  4//
  5// Earlier solvers kept states in a hash table at 36 bytes each (8 for the key,
  6// 4 for the index, 12 for the state, plus slack at a load factor of 0.5). At a
  7// billion states that is 36 GB, more than the machine has.
  8//
  9// With capture threshold one the game ends the moment a marker is removed, so
 10// **a non-terminal state always has p markers on each side**. With the count
 11// fixed, the configuration can be ranked directly and no hash table is needed at
 12// all. Two bits suffice for the value and one byte for the retrograde counter.
 13//
 14// ## Retrograde analysis
 15//
 16// WIN and LOSS are propagated backwards from the terminal positions. Whatever is
 17// still UNKNOWN once the propagation stops is a draw.
 18//
 19// "No winning move found" in a depth-limited search does not mean a draw.
 20// Handling repetition correctly, that is, revisiting the same board with the same
 21// side to move and the same forbidden move, needs a retrograde analysis that uses
 22// the finiteness of the reachable set.
 23//
 24// ## Why no predecessor lists
 25//
 26// Lists of predecessors cost memory. Instead the sweep is iterated, picking up
 27// states whose counter has reached zero on the next pass. The number of sweeps
 28// grows with the length of the decisive line, but each sweep is linear, so the
 29// whole run stays within a practical time.
 30//
 31// Build: g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -o build/solveidx src/solveidx.cpp
 32// Run  : ./build/solveidx <height> <width> <markers per player>
 33#include "rankgen.h"
 34#include <chrono>
 35#include <cstdint>
 36#include <cstdio>
 37#include <cstdlib>
 38#include <cstring>
 39#include <vector>
 40
 41static int NR, NC, NCELL, NPIECE;
 42static const int DR[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
 43static const int DC[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
 44static const uint8_t NO_MOVE = 0xFF;
 45
 46static inline bool inBoard(int r, int c) { return r >= 0 && r < NR && c >= 0 && c < NC; }
 47
 48// Applies a move. winner: 0 = game continues, 1 = the player to move removed an
 49// opponent marker, 2 = the player to move removed one of their own.
 50// The same logic as in solvepos.cpp / gapprobe.cpp (already verified).
 51static inline bool applyMove(uint64_t cur, uint64_t opp, uint8_t ban,
 52                             int from, int d,
 53                             uint64_t &ncur, uint64_t &nopp, uint8_t &nban,
 54                             int &winner) {
 55  if (!((cur >> from) & 1ULL)) return false;
 56  if (ban != NO_MOVE && ban == (uint8_t)((from << 2) | d)) return false;
 57  const uint64_t occ = cur | opp;
 58  const int dr = DR[d], dc = DC[d];
 59  int line[64], len = 1;
 60  line[0] = from;
 61  int rr = from / NC + dr, cc = from % NC + dc;
 62  int dest = inBoard(rr, cc) ? rr * NC + cc : -1;
 63  while (dest >= 0 && ((occ >> dest) & 1ULL)) {
 64    line[len++] = dest;
 65    rr = dest / NC + dr; cc = dest % NC + dc;
 66    dest = inBoard(rr, cc) ? rr * NC + cc : -1;
 67  }
 68  ncur = cur; nopp = opp;
 69  winner = 0;
 70  int hole = dest;
 71  for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 72    const uint64_t bit = 1ULL << line[i];
 73    if (ncur & bit) {
 74      ncur ^= bit;
 75      if (hole < 0) winner = 2; else ncur |= 1ULL << hole;
 76    } else {
 77      nopp ^= bit;
 78      if (hole < 0) winner = 1; else nopp |= 1ULL << hole;
 79    }
 80    hole = line[i];
 81  }
 82  if (winner != 0) { nban = NO_MOVE; return true; }
 83  // If an opponent marker came to rest on the landing square, the move that
 84  // pushes it back is the forbidden one.
 85  nban = NO_MOVE;
 86  if (dest >= 0 && ((nopp >> dest) & 1ULL)) nban = (uint8_t)((dest << 2) | (d ^ 1));
 87  // **Swap the side to move.** A state always keeps the player to move in cur,
 88  // so after a move the opponent becomes that player. Forgetting this builds a
 89  // tree in which one side moves forever, and the retrograde analysis is
 90  // meaningless.
 91  const uint64_t t = ncur; ncur = nopp; nopp = t;
 92  return true;
 93}
 94
 95// Collapses a forbidden move that can no longer be played: if the square it
 96// starts from holds no marker of the player to move, the restriction is vacuous.
 97// This keeps one position from being counted under several forbidden-move values.
 98static inline uint8_t killDeadBan(uint64_t cur, uint8_t ban) {
 99  if (ban != NO_MOVE && !((cur >> (ban >> 2)) & 1ULL)) return NO_MOVE;
100  return ban;
101}
102
103enum : uint8_t { UNKNOWN = 0, WIN = 1, LOSS = 2 };
104
105int main(int argc, char **argv) {
106  NR = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 4;
107  NC = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 4;
108  NPIECE = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : NC;
109  NCELL = NR * NC;
110  rankgen::init(NR, NC, NPIECE);
111
112  const uint64_t TOTAL = rankgen::TOTAL_CNT;
113  printf("board %dx%d, %d markers each, capture threshold 1\n", NR, NC, NPIECE);
114  printf("states  : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)TOTAL);
115  printf("memory  : %.2f GiB of values + %.2f GiB of counters\n\n",
116         TOTAL * 2.0 / 8 / 1073741824.0, TOTAL / 1073741824.0);
117  fflush(stdout);
118
119  auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
120
121  // value[i]: two bits holding UNKNOWN / WIN / LOSS
122  std::vector<uint8_t> value(TOTAL / 4 + 1, 0);
123  bool loaded = false;
124  if (const char *in = getenv("LOAD_VALUES")) {
125    FILE *fp = fopen(in, "rb");
126    if (fp) {
127      const size_t got = fread(value.data(), 1, value.size(), fp);
128      fclose(fp);
129      if (got == value.size()) {
130        loaded = true;
131        printf("values read from %s\n", in);
132      } else {
133        fprintf(stderr, "size read does not match: %zu != %zu\n",
134                got, value.size());
135        return 1;
136      }
137    }
138  }
139  auto getV = [&](uint64_t i) -> uint8_t {
140    return (value[i >> 2] >> ((i & 3) * 2)) & 3;
141  };
142  auto setV = [&](uint64_t i, uint8_t v) {
143    const uint64_t w = i >> 2;
144    const int sh = (i & 3) * 2;
145    value[w] = (uint8_t)((value[w] & ~(3 << sh)) | (v << sh));
146  };
147
148  // cnt[i]: how many successors are still UNKNOWN. At zero they are all wins for
149  // the opponent, so the state is a LOSS.
150  std::vector<uint8_t> cnt(TOTAL, 0);
151
152  // ## First pass: count the legal moves of each state and mark immediate wins
153  uint64_t nWin = 0, nLoss = 0;
154  for (uint64_t i = 0; loaded ? false : i < TOTAL; i++) {
155    uint64_t cur, opp; uint8_t ban;
156    rankgen::stateUnindex(i, cur, opp, ban);
157    // A self-removing move is never chosen, so it is not counted as a child.
158    // A position offering nothing else is a loss, since every move scores for the
159    // opponent. Getting this wrong leaves such positions UNKNOWN for ever and
160    // reports them as draws.
161    int child = 0;
162    bool immediateWin = false;
163    for (int from = 0; from < NCELL && !immediateWin; from++) {
164      if (!((cur >> from) & 1ULL)) continue;
165      for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
166        uint64_t nc2, no2; uint8_t nb2; int w;
167        if (!applyMove(cur, opp, ban, from, d, nc2, no2, nb2, w)) continue;
168        if (w == 1) { immediateWin = true; break; }   // can remove an opponent marker
169        if (w == 2) continue;                          // a self-removing move is never chosen
170        child++;
171      }
172    }
173    if (immediateWin) { setV(i, WIN); nWin++; cnt[i] = 0; }
174    else if (child == 0) { setV(i, LOSS); nLoss++; cnt[i] = 0; }  // no move to play: a loss
175    else cnt[i] = (uint8_t)(child > 255 ? 255 : child);
176    if ((i & 0xFFFFFFF) == 0 && i) {
177      printf("  first pass %llu / %llu\n", (unsigned long long)i, (unsigned long long)TOTAL);
178      fflush(stdout);
179    }
180  }
181  auto t1 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
182  printf("first pass done: %llu immediate wins, %llu with no move   %.1f s\n",
183         (unsigned long long)nWin, (unsigned long long)nLoss,
184         std::chrono::duration<double>(t1 - t0).count());
185  fflush(stdout);
186
187  // ## Second pass onwards: sweep until the propagation stops
188  //
189  //   a single LOSS among the successors makes the state a WIN
190  //   all successors WIN makes it a LOSS (cnt reaches zero)
191  //
192  // With no predecessor lists, the whole space is swept until nothing changes.
193  int round = 0;
194  for (; !loaded;) {
195    round++;
196    uint64_t changed = 0;
197    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < TOTAL; i++) {
198      if (getV(i) != UNKNOWN) continue;
199      uint64_t cur, opp; uint8_t ban;
200      rankgen::stateUnindex(i, cur, opp, ban);
201      int unknownLeft = 0;
202      bool anyLoss = false;
203      for (int from = 0; from < NCELL && !anyLoss; from++) {
204        if (!((cur >> from) & 1ULL)) continue;
205        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
206          uint64_t nc2, no2; uint8_t nb2; int w;
207          if (!applyMove(cur, opp, ban, from, d, nc2, no2, nb2, w)) continue;
208          if (w == 1) { anyLoss = true; break; }        // an immediate win, already handled in the first pass
209          if (w == 2) continue;                          // self-removal is never chosen; it scores for the opponent
210          nb2 = killDeadBan(nc2, nb2);
211          const uint64_t j = rankgen::stateIndex(nc2, no2, nb2);
212          const uint8_t v = getV(j);
213          if (v == LOSS) { anyLoss = true; break; }      // there is a move that loses for the opponent
214          if (v == UNKNOWN) unknownLeft++;
215        }
216      }
217      if (anyLoss) { setV(i, WIN); nWin++; changed++; }
218      else if (unknownLeft == 0) { setV(i, LOSS); nLoss++; changed++; }
219    }
220    auto t2 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
221    printf("  sweep %d: %llu changed, %llu wins, %llu losses   %.1f s\n",
222           round, (unsigned long long)changed,
223           (unsigned long long)nWin, (unsigned long long)nLoss,
224           std::chrono::duration<double>(t2 - t0).count());
225    fflush(stdout);
226    if (!changed) break;
227  }
228
229  // When values are loaded the counters are not restored, so recount.
230  if (loaded) {
231    nWin = nLoss = 0;
232    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < TOTAL; i++) {
233      const uint8_t v = getV(i);
234      if (v == WIN) nWin++;
235      else if (v == LOSS) nLoss++;
236    }
237  }
238
239  // ## Verdict for the initial position
240  uint64_t F = 0, S = 0;
241  for (int c = 0; c < NPIECE && c < NC; c++) {
242    S |= 1ULL << (0 * NC + c);
243    F |= 1ULL << ((NR - 1) * NC + c);
244  }
245  const uint64_t start = rankgen::stateIndex(F, S, NO_MOVE);
246  const uint8_t sv = getV(start);
247
248  // ## Saving the values
249  //
250  // Solving 5x5 takes three hours. Re-solving it for every spot check is not
251  // practical, so the result is written to a file.
252  if (const char *out = getenv("SAVE_VALUES")) {
253    FILE *fp = fopen(out, "wb");
254    if (fp) {
255      fwrite(value.data(), 1, value.size(), fp);
256      fclose(fp);
257      printf("values written to %s (%.2f GiB)\n",
258             out, value.size() / 1073741824.0);
259    } else {
260      fprintf(stderr, "failed to save: %s\n", out);
261    }
262  }
263
264  // ## Output for spot checks
265  //
266  // Reads indices from standard input and prints the value of each. Used to
267  // compare against the independent verdicts of sample5x5.
268  if (getenv("DUMP_INDEX")) {
269    unsigned long long qq;
270    while (scanf("%llu", &qq) == 1) {
271      const uint64_t q = (uint64_t)qq;
272      if (q >= TOTAL) { printf("%llu X\n", (unsigned long long)q); continue; }
273      const uint8_t v = getV(q);
274      printf("%llu %c\n", (unsigned long long)q,
275             v == WIN ? 'W' : v == LOSS ? 'L' : 'D');
276    }
277    fflush(stdout);
278  }
279
280  const uint64_t nDraw = TOTAL - nWin - nLoss;
281  printf("\n=== result ===\n");
282  printf("wins   : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)nWin);
283  printf("losses : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)nLoss);
284  printf("draws  : %llu\n", (unsigned long long)nDraw);
285  printf("initial position: %s\n",
286         sv == WIN ? "Black wins" : sv == LOSS ? "White wins" : "draw");
287  auto t3 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
288  printf("time   : %.1f s\n", std::chrono::duration<double>(t3 - t0).count());
289  return 0;
290}
